articles.reset-password: Reset your password: click 'Forgot password' on the sign-in page and follow the link we email you. Links expire after 30 minutes.
articles.change-email: Change the email address on your account under Settings > Profile. We send a confirmation link to the new address.
articles.two-factor: Turn on two-factor authentication under Settings > Security with an authenticator app or SMS codes.
articles.delete-account: Deleting your account removes all projects and data permanently after 14 days. Go to Settings > Account > Delete.
articles.export-data: Export all your projects as CSV or JSON from Settings > Data > Export. Large exports are emailed as a download link.
articles.import-csv: Import records from a CSV file: map the columns to fields, preview, then confirm. Files up to 50 MB are supported.
articles.invite-team: Invite teammates from Settings > Team > Invite. Each invitee gets an email and joins with the role you choose.
articles.roles-permissions: Roles: Owners manage billing and members, Admins manage projects, Editors change content, Viewers can only read.
articles.remove-member: Remove someone from your workspace under Settings > Team. Their content stays and is reassigned to you.
articles.plans-pricing: Plans: Free for 1 user, Pro at $12 per user per month, Business at $24 with SSO and audit logs.
articles.upgrade-plan: Upgrade anytime from Billing > Change plan. You pay the prorated difference for the rest of the month.
articles.cancel-subscription: Cancel your subscription in Billing > Cancel plan. You keep access until the end of the paid period.
articles.refund-policy: We refund annual plans within 30 days of purchase. Monthly plans are not refunded but can be cancelled anytime.
articles.invoices-vat: Download invoices from Billing > Invoices. Add your company name and VAT number there before the next invoice is issued.
articles.payment-failed: If a payment fails we retry three times over a week and email you. Update your card in Billing > Payment method.
articles.sso-setup: Set up single sign-on with Okta, Azure AD or Google Workspace on the Business plan under Settings > Security > SSO.
articles.api-keys: Create API keys under Settings > Developers. Keys inherit your permissions; rotate them if they may have leaked.
articles.rate-limits: The API allows 600 requests per minute per workspace. Responses include headers showing your remaining quota.
articles.webhooks: Webhooks send an HTTP POST when records change. We retry failed deliveries with backoff for up to 24 hours.
articles.zapier: Connect to 5,000 apps through our Zapier integration. Triggers fire when a record is created or updated.
articles.offline-mode: The mobile app works offline: changes sync automatically when your device reconnects.
articles.mobile-apps: Our apps are available for iOS 16+ and Android 10+. Sign in with the same account as on the web.
articles.notifications: Choose which emails and push notifications you receive under Settings > Notifications.
articles.dark-mode: Switch between light, dark and system themes under Settings > Appearance.
articles.custom-fields: Add custom fields such as dropdowns, dates and numbers to any project from Project settings > Fields.
articles.templates: Start a project from a template or save any project as a template to reuse its fields and views.
articles.data-location: Workspaces on the Business plan can choose to store data in the EU or the US.
articles.gdpr: We are GDPR compliant and sign a data processing agreement on request. See our privacy policy for sub-processors.
articles.uptime-status: See live service status and past incidents on status.example.com. Subscribe to get alerts.
articles.contact-support: Email support@example.com or use the chat in the app. Business customers get a 4-hour response time.
